questions.question: Simplify: (2x² + 3x - 1) + (x² - x + 4)
questions.explanation: Combine like terms: (2x² + x²) + (3x - x) + (-1 + 4) = 3x² + 2x + 3.
questions.fastStrategy: Combine like terms: same variable and exponent.

questions.question: Simplify: (5x³ + 2x² - x) - (2x³ - x² + 3x)
questions.explanation: Distribute negative: 5x³ + 2x² - x - 2x³ + x² - 3x. Combine: (5 - 2)x³ + (2 + 1)x² + (-1 - 3)x = 3x³ + 3x² - 4x.
steps: 1. Distribute negative sign: (5x³ + 2x² - x) - (2x³ - x² + 3x) = 5x³ + 2x² - x - 2x³ + x² - 3x.
questions.fastStrategy: Distribute negative sign to all terms being subtracted.

questions.question: What is the degree of the polynomial 3x⁴ + 2x² - x + 5?
questions.explanation: The degree is the highest exponent. The highest exponent is 4 (in 3x⁴).
questions.fastStrategy: Degree = highest exponent in the polynomial.

questions.question: Multiply: x(3x + 2)
questions.explanation: Distribute x: x × 3x + x × 2 = 3x² + 2x.
questions.fastStrategy: Distributive property: a(b + c) = ab + ac.
